item.text:
**(a) Social posts**

1. If superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, it will cause a catastrophe that kills at least a billion people. We must treat this as the urgent threat it is—and act before it’s too late.

2. We believe plainly: superintelligent AI built within the next 20 years will cause a catastrophe that kills at least a billion people. The stakes demand action now, not complacency.

3. A catastrophe that kills at least a billion people is not an acceptable price for building superintelligent AI. We know that if it’s built within the next 20 years, that catastrophe will happen. We must stop it.

**(b) Newsletter opening (105 words)**

We face a defining choice. If superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, it will cause a catastrophe that kills at least a billion people. We state this plainly because the stakes are too great for euphemism or delay. Building a system more capable than humanity without a way to control it puts every community, every country and every generation in danger. We cannot treat this future as inevitable, or let the race to build ever more powerful AI outrun our responsibility to protect people. We must act now to prevent superintelligent AI from being built and to keep this catastrophe from becoming reality.
